translation.name: Las Escrituras en Ashéninka Ucayali del Sur del Perú

content: Rowamahae-takiri Jacobo, romonkyahaetakiri Pedro
Ikanta pinkathari Herodes ipatzima-minthatakiri kemijantzinkari-paeni.
Ikantakaantaki ithatyahaeteri Jacobo, rirentzi Juan.

Ikanta iñaakiro Herodes kameetha inimotakiri Judá-paeni, raakaan-takiri Pedro. Ari awijayitakiri iroka-paeni roemoshirenkae-tziro rowanta-piintee-tawori ratanteetari kaari rowaeteetzi shineya-kaeroni.
Ikanta romonkyaa-kaantakiri Pedro, rowaki ikaatzi 16 owayiri aminakowenterini. Ikenkishiryaa-witaka Herodes roñaahanteri atziri-paeni othonkakyaa-rika roemoshirenkaetawo kitejeri Anonkoryaantsi.
Ijeeka-mintheetzi Pedro jempe romonkyahaetakiri, roetziñaarikotakawo kemijantzinkari-paeni ramanakotari Pedro ineshironkateeri Tajorentsi.
Romishitowae-teeri Pedro

Okanta omonkaatzi-mata-paaka raantyaariri Herodes irika Pedro roñaateri atziri-paeni. Ikanta imayira Pedro tsireniriki rojatekakiri apite owayiri, roojotee-tantakari apite eshirotha. Jeekaeya-tsini itsipa owayiri ikyaa-piinteetzi raminakowentziri.

Ari romapokaka ipokaki Ronampiri Awinkatharite, ikoñeetyakotapaakiri. Rotzinka-merikita-paakiri Pedro, rowakiryaakiri, ikantziri: “¡Pitzinee!” Tema oparya-shiwaetanaka eshirotha roojotee-tanta-kariri rakoki.
Rapiitakiri ronampiri Tajorentsi, ikantziri: “Powatha-kityaa, pikyaan-tyaari poyiri piitziki.” Imatakiro ikantee-takiriri Pedro. Eekiro ikantatzii ronampiri Tajorentsi: “Piwewirya-kotyaa, jame aate.”
Shitowanaki Pedro royaata-nakiri Ronampiri Tajorentsi, tee riyotzi kyaari-pero-rika okaatzi iñiiri, tema kimiwitaka iñaashireta-tyeeyaami.

Ikanta rawijanakiri apaani aminako-wentziriri, rawijanakiri itsipa. Rareeta-paakawo eshirota-tsiri ashitakowontsi, ashitaryaa-shiwaetanaka. Shitowae-yanakini. Ikanta ranashitee-yanakani, roo itaponeen-tanaka, ari rookaneeri ronampiri Tajorentsi, apaniroeni ranashitanaa.
Ari ikenkishiryaa-nakari Pedro, ikantanaki: “Ari niyotziri omaperota-tziiri Tajorentsi rotyaantakiri Ronampiri rookakaa-wentaana ikoshekinami Herodes, eejatzi Judá-paeni.”
Jatanaki Pedro opankoki María, riniro Juan, iiteetziri eejatzi Marcos, ari ipiyoteeyani kemijantzinkari-paeni ramaneeyani.
Areetapaaka Pedro ikyaa-piinteetzira, kaemapaaki. Okanta apaani ewankawo iitachari Rode, jatanaki aminiri iitarika kaematsiri.
Ari iyowaanteta-waeri Pedro, antawo okimo-shiretanaki, tee ashitaryaa-nakiniri ikyaanta-paakyaari, apatziro opiyanaka inthomoeki okamanta-paaki, okantzi: “Pedro kaematsiri.”
Ikantee-tziro ewankawo: “¡Tee pishinki-wenta!” Roo kanteencha eekiro oshintsitatzii ewankawo, okantzi: “Omaperotatyaa.” Ikanteeyini rirori: “Aamashitya Ronampiri Tajorentsi, kaari Pedro.”
Eekiro ishintsitatzii Pedro ikaemi. Ikanta rashitaryahae-takiniri, iñaatziiri Pedro, ari ipampoyeeyanakirini.

Ari rowaanka-nakiro rako Pedro imaeritan-teetyaari. Ikenkithata-kota-nakiro jempe ikanta Tajorentsi romishitowan-taariri. Eekiro ikantana-kitzii Pedro: “Pikamanteri Jacobo eejatzi itsipa noyemijantzinkaritepaeni.” Roojatzi ishitowantanaa, jatanaki otsipaki nampitsi.
Okanta okitejeta-manaki, osheki okantzi-motee-yakarini aminakowenta-witariri, tema tee riyotee-yini jempe ikinaki Pedro.

Ikantakaantaki Herodes raminamineeteeri, roo kanteencha tee iñetee-ri. Rootaki rookoetan-tanakariri aminakowenta-witariri, rotyaantaki owamayirini. Ikanta paata, shitowae Herodes inampiiteki Judá-paeni, jataki inampita-paentyaawo Cesarea-ki.
Ikamantakari Herodes

Ari ikantana-kityaa Herodes ikoshekari nampitawori Mapiniki eejatzi Shimaaki. Rootaki riyaatee-yanta-karini iñeeri Blasto, inampina Herodes, ikoyi raapatziyaari, tema ari riyomparita-piinteeyani. Ikanta irika Blasto ikowakaakiri Herodes raakameethata-wakiri.

Monkaata-paaka kitejeri ikaemakaan-takiri Herodes ikenkitha-waeta-kaeri. Ikyaanta-nakawo owaneenkawo iithaari ikenkitha-waetanta-piintari, jeeka-paaki ijeeka-mentoki ipiyotee-yakani, ikenkitha-waetanaki.
Ari ikaema-kotziri atziri-paeni, ikantzi: “¡Irinta ñaawaeteen-tsiri, Tajorentsira, kaari atziri!”
Tee imateeyaa Herodes roshiya-kaantee-takari Tajorentsi, ithaamentee-takari. Rootaki omapoka-shitan-tanakari romantsiyaakiri Ronampiri Tajorentsi, kiyowaetanaki, kamaki.
Roo kanteencha, eekiro iyaata-kota-nakitzii iñaani Tajorentsi, eekiro isheki-perota-nakitzii kemijantzin-karipaeni.
Ikanta Bernabé eejatzi Saulo imonkaatakiro rotyaantan-teeta-kariri Aapatziyaweniki, piyeeyaani Antioquía-ki, ari itsipataari Juan iiteetziri eejatzi Marcos.
